title: Concept: Python requirement pinned without a hash
description: requirements.txt declares a pinned requirement that carries no `--hash` value, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a hash the installer cannot verify the artifact, so a compromised index or proxy can serve different bytes for the same version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: Without a hash the installer cannot verify the artifact, so a compromised index or proxy can serve different bytes for the same version.
